sad.description: Grief, loss, extinction, decline, death, habitat destruction, climate despair.

ambient.description: Stillness, meditation, quiet awe, solitude, wonder, contemplation.

hopeful.description: Recovery, rescue, release, rehabilitation, triumph, playful or joyful, hopeful action.

sounds.mood_tags: piano, strings, slow build, cathartic swell
sounds.why_it_works: Classic 'save the species' arc — melancholic opening resolves into soaring strings. Reads as loss turning into hope.
sounds.use_case: Endangered-species montages, before/after rehab clips, time-lapse of habitat recovery

sounds.why_it_works: Quieter cousin of Experience — stays in the sadness rather than resolving. Works for loss, extinction, end-of-life sanctuary stories.
sounds.use_case: Tributes to deceased rescue animals, 'last of its kind' posts, orphaned wildlife

sounds.why_it_works: The 'wide shot' sound. Big, patient build feels like Planet Earth — scale, awe, the stakes of a whole ecosystem.
sounds.use_case: Drone footage, reveal shots of landscapes, 'we still have time' climate messaging

sounds.why_it_works: Has forward momentum — perfect for 'they made it' rescue/release moments (cub being released, whale swimming free).
sounds.use_case: Release-to-wild clips, migration footage, reforestation time-lapses

sounds.why_it_works: The heaviest sound on this list. Used in Arrival, The Leftovers — communicates collective grief. For poaching, oil spills, mass die-offs.
sounds.use_case: Climate grief posts, species-loss tributes, habitat destruction montages

sounds.why_it_works: Creates stillness. Instead of pushing emotion, it lets the viewer sit with the image — quiet awe of snow leopards, deep-sea footage, polar ice.
sounds.use_case: Slow-motion animal behavior, polar/underwater footage, 'lonely planet' vibes

sounds.why_it_works: Feels cold and vast — lends gravitas without being heavy-handed. Conservation accounts love this for Arctic/tundra and marine content.
sounds.use_case: Glacier footage, whale migrations, slow-pan landscape reels

sounds.why_it_works: Introspective rather than grand. Pairs well with 'what we're losing' voiceovers and quiet, handheld animal footage.
sounds.use_case: First-person rescue stories, volunteer diaries, sanctuary POV videos

sounds.why_it_works: Wonder and childlike awe — animals being curious, playful, being born. Reads as pure joy without being saccharine.
sounds.use_case: Baby animals, interspecies friendships, first-steps-of-a-calf moments

sounds.why_it_works: Warm, watery feeling — literally 'river' in the title. Reads as gentle release and continuity. Very 'donation CTA at the end' energy.
sounds.use_case: Rehabilitation progress clips, wildlife corridors, water/wetland content

sounds.why_it_works: Literally written for David Attenborough's 'The Crimson Wing.' Peak nature-doc DNA — gentle rise into a goosebumps peak.
sounds.use_case: Bird migrations, flock formations, release-to-sky moments, hero wide shots

sounds.why_it_works: Italian for 'becoming.' Builds patiently from solo piano to full orchestral — perfect narrative arc for 'from rescue to release.'
sounds.use_case: Long-form rehab journeys, rewilding stories, habitat restoration over time

sounds.why_it_works: Wordless guitar post-rock. Reads as 'quiet triumph' — not grand orchestra, more personal and earned.
sounds.use_case: Underdog recovery stories, hand-raised orphans, long-term sanctuary residents

sounds.why_it_works: The 'heroes are born' song. Huge, cathartic, modern-cinematic — when you want the viewer to feel like they just finished a film.
sounds.use_case: Campaign wrap-ups, year-in-review reels, 'you helped us do this' donor posts

sounds.why_it_works: Slowest and stillest on the list. Time dilates. For quiet awe — an old elephant, a sleeping orangutan, a dawn landscape.
sounds.use_case: End-of-life tributes, contemplative wide shots, 'pause and notice' posts
